S.FORM: == biyaw nu limucedan TOUCH TOUCH 鄰家女孩 == angnangan nu cudadan 主要情節 ina ka kungkuan u musakamuay tu api a malekakaay ci Sang-pin-ta-ye, Sang-pin atu biyaw tada cabay yu wawahenay ci Cin-cang-na a nikasasumidangan atu nisimsiman. wawa henay ci San-pin-ta u matinengay a miwenduay a tademaw, matinengay a midiput tu saba a kakaan. amica ku tuneng nida miwendu, makasic, makiayaw nu miyakiway a saba. i kaputan, ci Ta u sabelihay a kakaan ci nida. nanuwawa a malecabay a balakiay ci Siaw-nanan, mahida tu ku nikalecabay nu heni a tatusa, nika masasungaay ku nu heni. nika hinian nu heni katukuh i nipisasetsetan nu ayawan a labii. . ina satabakiay nu kakungkuan, ci He yu a tayda i kakadubaan a dadanan mangalay a miala tu cacay a wawaan hida satu a mapatay. ku mangalay atu saba masasetset atu ci Siaw-nanan nikahidaan sisa hida satu a malalum ku balucu'. sadikuday, paayaw tu saba aci Siaw-nanan a ni simsiman, ci Ta paytem sa milabu tu miyakiway. saicelang sa ci nida, itida ci nida ci Puo-ye-ing-e-lang a nipikunlinan, makaala ci nida tu cia-ce-yen a sapicumud nu payaan. malaheci tu ku nabalucu'an, ci Sang-pin maadih nida ku wayway nida tu sakasiicelangan, " ci Sang-pin-ta mikikaka tu kitakiday nu tademaw a mangalay tu ci Cin-cen-nanan. ." ina ka kungkuan masahicahicaay, kala babaluduhan, u yakiw atu sungalay ku kakakelidan, sayadah ku nipacumud tu katuuday nu tademawan. nikahidaan a nipatinakuan, idaw ku dihi atu pasenengay nu tademaw ci Ci-ten-kan, kasenengan sitangahay nika misapudahay nu tademaw ci Sin-ten-yu-cia, kapahay nu tangahan caay kaw manamuhay a miladladay a tademaw ci Cuo-cuo-mu. tawya u mamipasaicelang tu masasiningay a tademaw mangalay tu nu udip tu a kanamuhan misaicelangay nu kawawan. micudad tu nu cun-sya papasetset han kami aci He-he, pabali han kami tu mabelihay a tupel ni kaka, nika tatengan mikikaka henay kami tu sabaan. ma'ka micudad tu kaw-cung ku mangalay milabu tu miyakiway, nika wawah sa henay kami tu panan makatengil kami tu nipisiwkay ni Siaw-na tu ci nidaan amiale kaku sa, kilul sa kalaapapaan alaw tengtengen ni Yen-ten micumud tu mibusingguay. ci He nikapatayan tu nipisetsetan tu businguan, ci Ta mademec nida ku nu ayawan nanay a mihcaan nu kanggung. nikudan satu a nikasetsetan ci Hei-mu miala ci nida tu cacayay a sasulitan pasayda i sakakaay nu mibusiguay a tademaw pabeli tu kalisiw, sa malaheci nida ci Ta pataydan nida i miyakiway. silumaay a baki milaylay tu nakamu nu saba atu miyakiway a miwaitay tu malian a kitidaan atu nikudanay nu bangguan, alaen nida ku nidatengan ni Siaw-nan, atu kaput nu malecabayay misaicelang micumud taydan i cia-ce-yen. sadikuday nu picudadan tu sakatulu a mihcaan maala ku laluday nu cia-ce-yen a kacian sa musakamu atu nikaladay aci Siaw-nanan. . ci He-ta-ye, He-ye u masasungaayay ku nu heni, itida i cacudadan, micidek ku lakapah ni Siaw-na, kapah ku nipicudadan atu mangaay tu tademaw, kanamuhan nu tatama atu tataynaan. picudadan henay nu tulu a mihcaan makaala tu ci nida tu " hayu a limucedan" a nganganan. mikaw-cung satu, milabu ci nida tu miyakiway malakinli ci nida, micudad tu cacay a mihcaan atu ci He-ye makaala ku nuheni tu " sakasasungaay nu masasumidangay" a kawlahan. mapatay satu ci He-ye, mihantay ci Siaw-nu tu ci Taan mala miwaitay tu malaian a kainai'an nu tademaw, namahida ci Ta namakayda ci Hei-mu i pibusingguan miala ci nidaan, mahida ci nida miedap ci Taan caay pikai tu duma a masakaputay, masasungaay namin ku nu heni. 和達也, . idaw ku bahal sananay a kawawan, ci Cin-suy-wen-ce miawda ci Siaw-nanan, midayli tu madukaay nu milatlatay a tademaw a masasetset, saan ci nida tu ci nidaan u matinengay kaku atu misaicelangan kakau sa maala nida ku kapahay a tinsuan, namahida hida satu a malingatu tu milatlataay, nikudan satu kubian ni Puo-ye sayda. tu sadikuday inipisasetset i cacudadan makaala ci nida tu nu udip tu a sakapahay nu tinsuan. ci Siaw-nan nanu wawa tu a manamuh ci Ta-yean, pakay balucu' han nida, micili ci Ta-yean miculimek tu nabalucuan. micudad satu tu kaw-cung, ci Siaw-na sakamu satu tu namaka balucuay a nisimsiman, sadikuday, maladay tu ku nu heni, misaicelang tu tu sakatalaayaw a kawawan. . Puo-ye-ing elang 柏葉英二郎 masasiningay henay paayaw tu kaka a sicumi kapabaliwan nu taw u misapudahay a wawa sa, hiyaen nu Min-ci kawcung nu miyakiway a talakaway nu micudaday a tademaw u sapiedis ku sapibahbah ci nidaan a patahekal. ala han nu Si-wi a saydan pataydan i Min-cin kawcung mala miyakiway nu saydangan. mangalay mi'dis tu nabalucuan tu linges i miyakiway a tademaw, misuayaw tu ci Ta-ye nu henian a micidek ku nipikunlingan, sisa kapah satu ku nipihini a mikunling. sadikuday masumad ci Ta-yean, itini i niyadu'an a nikasasetsetan idaw ku picidekan nu nipatudu'an, miladay tu miyakiway micumud i cia-ce-yen. pihaceng ku adada' nu mata, hedek sa ku nikasasetsetan nu niyadu'an ales satu ci nida taydan nida miniwing. . Ci-ten-kan 吉田剛 pahalhalay nu nikudanay a miwaitay tu mali, banggu nu nikudan cacay a bataan. nikudan nu cacay a mihcaan mala, sayaway kasenengay nu kanamuhan a tademaw ci Sang-pi-ta-ye, kakilulan, minanam tu amelikay nu patelekay nu malian. ci Ci-ta mademec ni se-nan kawcung ci Si-cun-yun, ci Ci-ten mapatay a minanam tu mali ni Si-cun nu sakasumad a malian. nipinanam henay tu mal isa, ci Ta-ye miwait sa masikeda ni Sin-ten-min-yun, ci Ci-ten sumaden nida ku mali maawce ci Sin-ten. nama hida, ci Ci-tan u sakasetset ni Ta-ye ci nida, malaada a tademaw. . ku mangalay atu ci Ta-yean a masasetset tu wangpay nu miwaitay a mali nu kitidaan, nika a malimad ku kakulian ni ama i nutawan a niyadu'an sisa miladay a mabulaw, hida satu kina kawaw, taluma' aca i ada nu miyakiway atu ci Ta-ye a masasetset mapatay nu demec, la'cu's satu ku wayway, edis satu tu udip. . itini i gagikian " TOUCH biyaw nu limucedan TV Special i nikudanay nu misu" nu nikaian a cudadan na idaw ci Ci-ten, ina gikian idaw ku nipatucekan tu tusaay a kulitan, ci Cin-cen aci Ta-ye aci misulitay a tademaw malawlaw i kasasumidangan, ni kaian nu cudadan ci Suy-ye-cia-tay-ce adada', idaw henay ku nipatucekan tu nikataluma' ni Ci-ten, ci Ta-sye aci Cin-cen-nan malecad ku cacudadan, u miyakiway a wangpayan, kanamuhan ci Cin-cen-nan, mademec ci Cin-cen aci Ci-ten tu nikasasetsetan nu nipiyakiwan sa tahekal ku nuhein masasuadih, hang satu tu ci Ci-tenan, ci Ci-ten misungaay ci Cin-cen-nanan. duma satu ci Suy-ye-tay-ce aci Ta-ye i hekal a milabin, saan tu ci Ta-yean sapaculi ci Cin-cen-nan, ci Cin-cen tu ci Ta-yean mapatay nu linges. ci Ci-ten mangalay tu ci Cin-cen a malaliyas aci Ta-yean. sadikuday ci Ci-ten aci Suy-ye tahekal saca i nuayawan, paytem sa miabibi ci Cin-cen-nanan sapaseneng, ci Ta-ye aci Cin-cen saan idaw ku mamidang nu nida saan, sutedeptedep saan manamuh aca ci Ci-ten. sadikuday nina nikai'an a cudadan misumad aca a misulit, kaiyan ci Ci-ten, padumaen tu ci Sin-tenan.
